title: 第1章 礼物
content_zh:
第1章礼物
松海市。
早上七点半，昏暗的房间里，松软的大床上，张元清陡然惊醒，捂着头，弓身如虾。
头痛的像是要裂开，脑袋里如同嵌了钢针，疼的头皮都在抽搐，以至于产生了幻听、幻觉，脑海里闪过纷乱的画面，耳边尽是嘈杂的、没有意义的噪音。
张元清知道旧疾复发了。
颤巍巍的从床上爬起来，拉开床头柜的抽屉，哆哆嗦嗦的摸到药瓶，迫不及待的拧开，倒了五六颗蓝色小药丸，囫囵吞下。
然后，他把自己摔回床上，大口喘息，忍耐剧痛。
十几秒后，撕裂灵魂的头痛减弱，继而平复。
“呼”张元清如释重负的吐出一口气，满头冷汗。
他读高中时得了一场怪病，症状是大脑不受控制的回忆起过往的所有记忆，包括被遗忘的垃圾信息；不受控制的采集外界信息，进行分析；大脑对身体的掌控达到一个不可思议的程度。
幸运的是，这种状态无法持续太久，就会因为身体不堪重负而中断。
正是因为这种能力，他玩儿似的考上松海大学——全国排名前列的名牌学府。
张元清把这种状态称为大脑过载，他认为自己可能要进化成超人了，但因为身体无法支撑这种进化，才频频中断。
当他把这个猜测告诉医生时，医生表示听不懂，但大受震撼，并建议他去楼下的精神科看看。
总之医院也查不出病因，后来，老妈从国外给他带回来了特效药，病情这才得到控制，只要定期吃药，就不会发作。
“一准是昨晚没休息好，太累了，都怪江玉饵，大半夜的非要来我房间打游戏”
嘴上虽然这么说，但内心却悄然沉重，因为张元清知道，药效的作用开始减弱，自己的病症越来越严重了。
“以后要加大药量了.”张元清穿上棉拖鞋，来到窗边，‘刷’的拉开帘子。
阳光争先恐后的涌进来，把房间填满。
松海市的四月，春光明媚，迎面而来的晨风清凉舒适。

“咚咚！”
这时，敲门声传来，外婆在门外喊道：
“元子，起床了。”
“不起！”张元清冷酷无情的拒绝，他想睡回笼觉。
春光明媚，又是周末，不睡懒觉岂不是浪费人生？
“给你三分钟，不起床我就泼醒你。”
外婆更加冷酷无情。
“知道了知道了.”张元清立刻服软。
他知道脾气暴躁的外婆真能干出这事儿。
在张元清还读小学时，父亲就因车祸去世了，性格刚强的母亲没有再婚，把儿子带回松海定居，丢给了外公外婆照顾。
自己则一头扎进事业里，成为亲戚们交口称赞的女强人。
后来母亲自己也买了房，但张元清不喜欢那个空荡荡的大平层，依旧和外公外婆一起住。
反正老妈每天早出晚归，隔三差五的出差，一心扑在事业上，周末就算不加班，到了饭点也是点外卖。
对他这个儿子说得最多的，就是“钱够不够用，不够要跟妈妈说”，一个能在经济上无限满足你的女强人母亲，听起来很不错。
但张元清总是笑眯眯的对母亲说：外婆和舅妈给的零花钱够用。
嗯，还有小姨。
昨晚非要来他房间打游戏的女人就是他小姨。
张元清打了个哈欠，拧开卧室的门把手，来到客厅。
外婆家里的这套房子，算上公摊面积有一百五十平米，当年卖老房子购置这套新房时，张元清记得每平米四万多。
六七年过去，现在这片小区的房价涨到一平米11万，翻了近两倍。

也幸亏外公当年有先见之明，换成之前的老房子，张元清就只能睡客厅了，毕竟现在长大了，不能再跟小姨睡了。
客厅边的长条餐桌上，害他头疼的罪魁祸首‘咕咕咕’的喝着粥，粉色的拖鞋在桌底翘啊翘。
她五官精致漂亮，圆润的鹅蛋脸看起来颇为甜美，右眼角有一颗泪痣。
刚起床的缘故，蓬松凌乱的大波浪披散着，让她多了几分慵懒妩媚。
小姨叫江玉饵，比他大四岁。
看到张元清出来，小姨舔了一口嘴边的粥，惊讶道：
“呦，起这么早，这不像你的风格。”
“你妈干的好事。”
“你怎么骂人呢。”
“我只是实话实说。”
张元清审视着小姨如花似玉的漂亮脸蛋，精神抖擞，明媚动人。
都说黑夜不会亏待熬夜的人，它会赐你黑眼圈，但这个定律在眼前的女人身上似乎不管用。
厨房里的外婆听到动静，探出头看了看，片刻后，端着一碗粥出来。
外婆乌发中夹杂银丝，眼神很锐利，一看就是那种脾气不好的老太太。
虽然松弛的皮肤和浅浅的皱纹夺走了她的风华，但依稀能看出年轻时拥有不错的颜值。
张元清接过外婆递来的粥，咕噜噜灌了一口，说：
“外公呢？”
“出去遛弯了。”外婆说。
外公是退休老刑警，即使年纪大了，生活依然很规律，每晚十点必睡，早上六点就醒。
漂亮小姨喝着粥，笑嘻嘻道：

“吃完早饭，姨带你去逛商场买衣服。”
你有这么好心？张元清正要答应，身边的外婆充满杀气的横他一眼：
“你敢去就打断狗腿。”
“妈你怎么这样。”小姨一脸婊气的说：“我只是想给元子买几件春季装，您就不乐意了？外甥虽然有个外字，但也是亲的呀～”
外婆一力破万法，“你也想被打断狗腿？”
小姨撇撇嘴，低头喝粥。
张元清一听母女俩的博弈，就知道外婆一准儿是又给小姨安排相亲了，古灵精怪的小姨则想拉他去搅浑水。
以往都是这么干的，带着外甥去相亲，坐几分钟，社交牛逼症的外甥就会把相亲对象搞定，两个男人相谈甚欢，从民生大计聊到世界格局，全程没她什么事。
她只要喝着饮料玩手机就行了，相亲对象还会觉得自己在美人面前展现出了足够的社会阅历和见识，从而感到高兴，自我感觉良好。
江玉饵从小就精致可爱，是街坊邻居们夸赞的对象，颜值高，甜美乖巧，很讨长辈喜欢。
这么漂亮的闺女，外婆当然要严防死守，读初中时就耳提面命不准早恋，不准和男同学出去玩。
小女儿果然没让她失望，直到大学毕业也没交过男朋友，可进了社会，尤其是年初过了25岁生日后，外婆就有些坐不住了。
心说我只是不让你早恋，没让你当剩女啊，女人能有几年青春？
于是召集老姐妹们，五湖四海的搜罗青年才俊的资料，为女儿张罗着相亲。
“外婆啊，她这摆明了还不想谈对象，强扭的瓜不甜。”张元清一边啃包子，一边毛遂自荐道：
“您要不替我张罗一下相亲？我这颗瓜可甜了。”
外婆怒道：“你还小，急什么。大学里都是女同学，自己不会找？再捣乱小心我揍你。”
外婆是南方女人，但脾气半点都不温婉，特别火爆。
就算是张元清那个事业女强人的母亲，也不敢顶撞外婆。
我长大了好吧，都做了好几年的手艺人了张元清心里嘀咕。

吃完早饭，小姨在外婆强势要求下，回房间换衣服化妆，外出相亲。
小姨化了淡淡的妆，这让她看起来愈发的明艳动人。
蓬松的圆领针织衫搭配一件长款外套，浅色窄口牛仔裤包裹两条大长腿，匀称圆润。窄口裤脚收在黑色马丁靴里。
森系简约风格的打扮，不妖艳不浮华，又特别精致。
小姨朝他抛了一个“你懂的”小眼神，拎着包包，扭着小腰出门：
“妈，我出去相亲啦。”
张元清回到房间，不疾不徐的换上黑色T恤、冲锋衣，穿上跑鞋。
隔了几分钟，拉开卧室的门。
外婆在客厅里打扫卫生，见他出来，停下手头的工作，默默看着他。
张元清学着小姨的语气：
“妈，我也出去相亲啦。”
“滚回来。”外婆扬起扫帚，威胁道：“敢迈出这个门，狗腿打断。”
“好的！”张元清从善如流的返回卧室。
坐在书桌边，他捧着手机给小姨发了条信息：
“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟。”
“说人话！”
小姨应该在开车，回复的内容言简意赅。
“我被外婆拦在家里了，你还是自己去相亲吧。”
小姨发来一条语音。
张元清点开，扬声器里响起江玉饵气呼呼的声音：

“要你何用！！”
小姨撤回了一条语音，接着发来另一条，这次换了副语气，娇滴滴的撒娇卖萌：
“好外甥，快来嘛，小姨最疼你了，Mua～”
呵，女人！
撒个娇卖个萌就想让我触外婆的逆鳞？至少也得发个红包啊。
这时，略显刺耳的铃声传来，张元清来到客厅，在外婆的注视下，按下楼宇对讲的通话按钮，道：
“哪位！”
“快递。”
扬声器里传来声音。
张元清按下开门键，隔了两三分钟，穿着制服的快递小哥乘电梯上楼，怀里抱着一个包裹：
“是张元清吗。”
“是我。”
我没有网购啊他一脸困惑的签收，看了一眼包裹信息，包裹没写寄件人，但地址是隔壁江南省杭城。
他返回房间，从书桌抽屉里找出裁纸刀，
里面是防摔气垫包裹着一张黑色的卡片，一封黄皮信件。
张元清拿起身份证大小的黑色卡片，材质似乎是金属，但触手极为温润，卡片做的非常精美，边缘是浅浅的银色云纹，中央一轮黑色圆月。
黑色圆月印的很精致，表面不规则的斑块清晰可见。
什么东西？怀着疑惑的心情，他拆开了信封，展开了信件。
“元子，我得到了一件很有趣的东西，曾以为它能改变我的人生，可我能力有限，无法驾驭它。我觉得，如果是你的话，应该不成问题。
“兄弟一场，这是我送你的礼物。

“雷一兵！”

content_en:
Chapter 1 Gift
Songhai City.
At 7:30 in the morning, Zhang Yuanqing suddenly woke up on the soft big bed in the dark room, covering his head and arching his body like a shrimp.
My headache felt like it was about to split, my head felt like there were steel needles embedded in it, my painful scalp was twitching, so much so that I had auditory hallucinations and hallucinations, chaotic pictures flashed through my mind, and my ears were filled with noisy, meaningless noises.
Zhang Yuanqing knew that the old disease had returned.
He climbed up from the bed shakily, opened the drawer of the bedside table, tremblingly touched the medicine bottle, unscrewed it eagerly, poured five or six small blue pills, and swallowed them whole.
Then, he threw himself back on the bed, gasping for breath and enduring the severe pain.
After more than ten seconds, the soul-rending headache weakened and then subsided.
"Huh!" Zhang Yuanqing breathed out a sigh of relief, his head covered with cold sweat.
When he was in high school, he contracted a strange disease. The symptoms were that his brain uncontrollably recalled all past memories, including forgotten junk information; it uncontrollably collected and analyzed external information; and the brain controlled the body to an incredible degree.
Fortunately, this state cannot last long before the body becomes overwhelmed.
It was precisely because of this ability that he was admitted to Songhai University, a prestigious university ranked among the top in the country.
Zhang Yuanqing called this state brain overload. He thought he might evolve into a superman, but he frequently interrupted because his body could not support this evolution.
When he told the doctor about this speculation, the doctor said he didn't understand, but was shocked and suggested that he go to the psychiatric department downstairs.
In short, the hospital could not find the cause. Later, his mother brought him special medicine from abroad, and the condition was under control. As long as he took medicine regularly, he would not have an attack.
"I must have not had a good rest last night. I was too tired. It's all Jiang Yubai's fault. He insisted on coming to my room to play games in the middle of the night."
Although he said this, his heart felt heavy because Zhang Yuanqing knew that the effect of the medicine was beginning to weaken and his illness was getting worse.
"I will need to increase the dose of medicine in the future." Zhang Yuanqing put on his cotton slippers, came to the window, and opened the curtain with a "swipe".
Sunlight rushes in, filling the room.
In April in Songhai City, the spring scenery is bright and the oncoming morning breeze is cool and comfortable.
"Boom!"
At this time, there was a knock on the door, and grandma shouted outside the door:
"Motoko, wake up."
"I can't afford it!" Zhang Yuanqing refused ruthlessly. He wanted to go back to sleep.
Spring is beautiful and it’s the weekend. Wouldn’t it be a waste of life not to sleep in?
"Give you three minutes. If you don't get up, I'll wake you up."
Grandma was even more ruthless.
"I know, I know." Zhang Yuanqing immediately surrendered.
He knew that his grumpy grandmother was really capable of such a thing.
When Zhang Yuanqing was still in elementary school, his father died in a car accident. His strong-willed mother did not remarry and took her son back to Songhai to settle down, leaving him in the care of his grandparents.
She plunged into her career and became a strong woman praised by her relatives.
Later, her mother bought a house herself, but Zhang Yuanqing didn't like the empty flat floor, so she still lived with her grandparents.
Anyway, my mother leaves early and comes back late every day. She goes on business trips every now and then. She focuses on her career. Even if she doesn’t work overtime on weekends, she still orders takeout when it’s time for meals.
What he said most to his son was, "If you have enough money, you have to tell your mother if you don't have enough." A strong woman mother who can satisfy you financially sounds very good.
But Zhang Yuanqing always smiled and said to his mother: The pocket money given by grandma and aunt is enough.
Well, there is also my aunt.
The woman who insisted on coming to his room to play games last night was his aunt.
Zhang Yuanqing yawned, turned on the bedroom door handle, and came to the living room.
The house in my grandma’s house has an area of ​​150 square meters including the shared area. When he sold his old house to buy this new house, Zhang Yuanqing remembered every day.More than 40,000 square meters.
Six or seven years later, the house price in this community has now risen to 110,000 yuan per square meter, nearly tripling.
Fortunately, his grandfather had the foresight to change it to the old house. Zhang Yuanqing could only sleep in the living room. After all, he had grown up and could no longer sleep with his aunt.
On the long dining table next to the living room, the culprit who caused his headache was sipping porridge with his pink slippers curled up on the bottom of the table.
Her facial features are exquisite and beautiful, her round oval face looks quite sweet, and she has a tear mole on the corner of her right eye.
Because she had just gotten up, her big fluffy and messy waves were spreading, making her a little more lazy and charming.
His aunt's name is Jiang Yuyi, and she is four years older than him.
Seeing Zhang Yuanqing come out, my aunt licked the porridge on her lips and said in surprise:
"Hey, it's not like you to get up so early."
"Your mother did a good job."
"Why are you swearing?"
"I'm just telling the truth."
Zhang Yuanqing looked at his aunt's pretty face, which was full of energy and bright.
It is said that the night will not be kind to those who stay up late, it will give you dark circles, but this law does not seem to apply to the woman in front of you.
Grandma in the kitchen heard the noise and stuck her head out to take a look. After a while, she came out with a bowl of porridge.
Grandma has silver strands in her black hair and sharp eyes. At first glance, she looks like an old lady with a bad temper.
Although her loose skin and shallow wrinkles took away her elegance, she could still vaguely see that she had good looks when she was young.
Zhang Yuanqing took the porridge from his grandmother, took a sip and said:
"Where's grandpa?"
"Going out for a walk." Grandma said.
My grandfather is a retired criminal policeman. Even though he is older, his life is still very regular. He must go to bed at ten o'clock every night and wake up at six o'clock in the morning.
The beautiful aunt drank the porridge and said with a smile:
"After breakfast, Auntie will take you to the mall to buy clothes."
Are you so kind? Zhang Yuanqing was about to agree when the grandmother beside him gave him a murderous look:
"Break the dog's legs if you dare to go."
"Mom, why are you like this?" the aunt said with a bitch look on her face: "I just want to buy some spring clothes for Motoko, but you are not happy? Although my nephew has a foreign name, he is still dear~"
Grandma tried her best to overcome all obstacles, "You also want to have your legs broken?"
The aunt curled her lips and lowered her head to drink the porridge.
As soon as Zhang Yuanqing heard about the game between mother and daughter, he knew that his grandmother must have arranged a blind date for his aunt again, and the eccentric aunt wanted to get him to stir up the troubled waters.
This is what they did in the past. They took their nephew on a blind date. After a few minutes of sitting there, the socially awkward nephew would find a date. The two men had a great time talking about everything from people's livelihood plans to the world structure. She didn't have anything to worry about the whole time.
All she needs to do is drink and play with her mobile phone, and her blind date will feel that she has shown enough social experience and knowledge in front of the beauty, so she will feel happy and feel good about herself.
Jiang Yuyi has been cute and cute since she was a child. She is the object of praise from her neighbors. She is good-looking, sweet and well-behaved, and is very popular with her elders.
Of course, my grandmother had to strictly guard against such a beautiful girl. When she was in junior high school, she warned her not to fall in love early or hang out with male classmates.
As expected, her youngest daughter did not disappoint her. She never had a boyfriend until she graduated from college. But once she entered society, especially after her 25th birthday at the beginning of the year, her grandmother became a little unable to sit still.
My heart says that I just don’t let you fall in love prematurely, and I don’t let you be a leftover girl. How many years can a woman stay young?
So I called together old sisters to collect information about young talents from all over the world, and arranged a blind date for my daughter.
"Grandma, it's clear that she still doesn't want to talk to someone. It's not sweet to be so coquettish." Zhang Yuanqing introduced himself while chewing the buns:
"Why don't you help me arrange a blind date? I'm so sweet."
Grandma said angrily: "You are still young, why are you so anxious? There are only female classmates in college, and you don't know how to find one? If you make trouble again, be careful and I will beat you up."
Grandma is a southern woman, but she has no temper at all.Not gentle, extremely hot.
Even Zhang Yuanqing's mother, a career woman, did not dare to contradict her grandmother.
When I grow up, okay, I have been a craftsman for several years. Zhang Yuanqing murmured in his heart.
After breakfast, my aunt went back to her room to change clothes, put on makeup, and go out on a blind date at the strong request of her grandma.
The aunt put on light makeup, which made her look even more beautiful.
The fluffy round-neck sweater is paired with a long jacket, and the light-colored narrow-mouth jeans wrap up the two long legs, which are well-proportioned and round. The narrow trousers are tucked into black Martin boots.
The forest style simple style of dress is neither glamorous nor flashy, but also very refined.
The aunt gave him a "you know" look, carried her bag, and went out with her waist twisted:
"Mom, I'm going on a blind date."
Zhang Yuanqing returned to the room and quickly put on a black T-shirt, a jacket, and running shoes.
After a few minutes, he opened the bedroom door.
Grandma was cleaning in the living room. When she saw him coming out, she stopped what she was doing and looked at him silently.
Zhang Yuanqing imitated his aunt's tone:
"Mom, I'm going on a blind date too."
"Come back." Grandma raised her broom and threatened: "If you dare to step out of this door, your dog's legs will be broken."
"Okay!" Zhang Yuanqing returned to the bedroom calmly.
Sitting at the desk, he held his mobile phone and sent a message to his aunt:
"Died before leaving the army, it makes the hero burst into tears."
"Speak humanly!"
My aunt was probably driving, and her reply was concise and to the point.
"I was stopped at home by my grandma. You should go on a blind date by yourself."
My aunt sent a voice message.
Zhang Yuan started counting, and Jiang Yuyi's angry voice sounded from the loudspeaker:
"What use do you have!!"
The aunt withdrew one voice message, and then sent another one, this time with a different tone, coquettishly and cutely:
"Good nephew, come quickly, my aunt loves you the most, Mua~"
Oh, woman!
You want me to touch my grandma's vagina by acting coquettishly and cutely? At least I have to give out a red envelope.
At this time, a slightly harsh ringtone came. Zhang Yuanqing came to the living room. Under the gaze of his grandmother, he pressed the call button on the building intercom and said:
"Which one!"
"Express delivery."
A voice came from the speaker.
Zhang Yuanqing pressed the door-open button, and after two or three minutes, a courier boy in uniform took the elevator upstairs, holding a package in his arms:
"Is it Zhang Yuanqing?"
"It's me."
I didn't shop online. He signed for it with a confused look on his face and took a look at the package information. The package didn't have a sender on it, but the address was Hangcheng, Jiangnan Province next door.
He returned to the room and found the paper knife from the desk drawer.
